comparison.objective: Sort six bottles by color between crowded rack shelves without destabilizing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated constrained pick-and-place, upright transport, obstacle avoidance, and stable shelf placement.
comparison.success_condition: All bottles correctly shelved and stable for two seconds; excessive tilt, fall, workspace exit, or neighboring disturbance permanently fails.
comparison.reason: This tests discrete classification and placement of bottles, not bulk physical separation by size through a screen. No material rubric detail is missing.
